ui.disclaimer: Practice only. Real market results are unpredictable, and nothing here is advice.

voice_explainers.home: This is the practice terminal. All prices are random demo numbers, no real money.
voice_explainers.chart: This chart shows candles. Green closed higher, red closed lower. The orange line is a five candle average.
voice_explainers.watch: The watchlist shows each stock and its change today. Tap Why to see an invented story.
voice_explainers.ticket: Choose buy or sell, then market, limit or stop-loss, enter quantity, and place a practice order.
voice_explainers.depth: Market depth shows buyers on the left and sellers on the right. The gap between them is the spread, a hidden cost.
voice_explainers.port: Your portfolio shows shares you hold, your average price and profit or loss on paper.
voice_explainers.learn: This is the skill tree. Finish short lessons from basics to hard. Wrong answers cost a heart.
voice_explainers.nine: In this game you face a midnight scam and a panic morning. It measures resilience, not profit.
voice_explainers.scam: Read the message and choose the safest move. Urgency, secrecy and guaranteed returns are red flags.
voice_explainers.quiz: Choose a level and answer ten questions. Three right in a row multiplies your XP.
voice_explainers.terms: Each card shows a money term, its full form and meaning. Tap a card for an everyday picture.
